sources.title: AI Model Parameters Explained: 2B vs 7B vs 40B and Beyond
sources.snippet: What does it mean when an AI model has 4B, 7B, or 70B parameters, or a name like 235B-A22B? Learn how parameter count affects performance, hardware needs, and what developers and homelabbers should know before downloading and running these models.
